label: advances legislative measures through body
definition: Political actor X advances a legislative measure through legislative body Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit pushing or advancing legislation through Y; historical legislative action. Excludes: gaining control of or taking over the body; ordinary membership, lobbying or communication without advancing a measure; physical movement through a building. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: push-through with the legislative object omitted; unclear proposer or legislative body; prospective intent without established action. The legislation is a third role and must be locally recoverable; bare push-through does not identify the measure or guarantee passage.
